verdict.rationale: Missive ships an automation rules engine: pricing advertises "Automate your workflows — Up to 1000 rules." The changelog confirms rules perform actions such as creating drafts automatically, and webhooks are listed among the developer tools for event-driven integration. The evidence only establishes that rules exist and take actions; it does not describe how they work. missing for 10: documentation of trigger events, conditions, and the available action types; any AI-specific rule actions; independent or hands-on corroboration of rule behavior.
